newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Sukamto sells 8.25 mln Transmarco shares.
newsitem.headline: Sukamto sells 8.25 mln Transmarco shares.

text.p: Substantial shareholder Sukamto Sia has agreed to sell 8.25 million shares in Transmarco Ltd at Singapore $9.45 a share to Miel Investment Corporation, a statement from Standard Chartered Merchant Bank Asia said on Monday.

The statement said, Miel Investment Corp, whose sole director is Jonathan Sampoerna, son of Indonesian tobacco tycoon, Putera Sampoerna, bought Sia's stake from Arton Pte Ltd, a company in which Sia is controlling shareholder.
It said with the acquisition, Sampoerna now has a 65.77 percent stake in Transmarco or 18.086 million shares, making Miel's takeover offer for Transmarco unconditional.
Sampoerna held 35.77 pecent of Transmarco's issued share capital prior to today's announcement.
With the latest purchase, Miel Investment Corp is also increasing its takeover offer price to S$9.45 a share for all outstanding Transmarco shares, up from its previous offer of S$8.55.
Shares of Transmarco, a trading and telecommunications firm, closed at S$10.70 prior to its suspension on Monday.
The statement said Swiss Bank Corp has confirmed Miel Investment Corp has "sufficient financial resources" to purchase Transmarco shares at the revised offer price.
Standard Chartered, together with Swiss Bank Corp, are acting for Miel Investment.-- Singapore newsroom (65 8703080)
